pick.instructions: Which option should I choose? You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Every unlocked option that does not certainly kill you is listed; options that cost HP carry hp_after (and, with a forced fight ahead, how that HP compares with the fight's measured cost). Code does not rule HP trades out: that is your call. facts.event.option_outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after each option, by option key. boss_sim on an option: this act's boss fought to the end in simulation with the deck (and HP) that option leaves, against your current deck on the same random seeds: the win rate (calibrated on logged boss fights), the difference ± its standard error, the median HP lost in the won fights and the turns. facts.act_boss_sim gives the start, the method and its limits; it replaces the act boss clock. 构筑评估将组件数量与战斗兑现分列。比较拿/跳/删/升级的完整战斗DPR、配对差及误差、掉血、核心具名牌施放覆盖和首次施放回合；不能只因多一张组件就判更好，也不能只最大化DPR。抽牌稀释需看同题模拟中的施放覆盖/回合差，未知时明确说明，不能拿未施放=0回合或总动作数冒充完整循环。未来组件概率未通过对应校准时不用于数值排序；完整核心资格与最终通关率未知时不编造。若本题更新run_plan，必须给construction={primary,alternatives,checkpoint,reason,pivot_if}；primary取coreCatalog的ID，暂不押方向可填uncommitted。checkpoint为大于当前层的复查层数，reason说明证据和取舍，pivot_if说明转向条件。 Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_relative_margin或bossMargin明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。 ALSO DUE NOW: your run plan (state.run_plan_task says why, and where your current plan is). Settle it first, then decide this question with it in mind. You set the STRATEGY for the rest of this act and run; code and a small model will apply it to card rewards, shops, removals, map routes and rest sites, and will play every card themselves. Look at the deck, relics, HP, gold, potions, the act boss and the map ahead (memory.lookahead). Name what this deck needs to beat the act boss and survive the act. act_boss_clock gives the boss's HP at this ascension (heals and wasted hits included), the turns you survive at its logged damage and so the turns the fight can last, the damage a turn that needs, and code's estimate of this deck's damage a turn in that fight (calibrated on logged A8 boss fights; Strength growth and the boss mechanic in harder_because counted). If gap_per_turn > 0, closing it comes first: want Strength/scaling and high-damage cards (AoE for two-part bosses), remove Strikes/Defends that dilute them, smith attacks; state the gap in the summary. A gap of 0 is not a reason to stop adding damage: the estimate's typical error is ~25%. Reply to this question in its own JSON format as asked, with one more field in the same JSON object: "run_plan": {"archetype": "<the deck direction, max 12 words>", "want": [card ids to pick when offered, most important first, max 6], "avoid": [card ids not to take, max 6], "remove": [card ids in the deck to remove first, max 3], "block_target": <number of block cards the deck should hold by the act boss>, "elites": "seek" | "normal" | "avoid", "rest": "heal" | "smith" | "auto", "boss_prep": "<max 30 words: what to have ready for the act boss>", "summary": "<max 40 words: the plan in plain words>"}

build_ranking.limits: 同题同种子逐样本配对；先胜率、再合格S、最后配对掉血。只比较已模拟候选，未模拟选项保留未知；S不是胜率，缺口诊断不参与排序。大脑可偏离，但须说明理由。按需采样：各候选统计用自己的n；配对只用两者共有前缀，较短候选对基准的差不引用基准后续样本。

selection.ranking_override_reason: Only Injury was modeled; neither alternative's benefit was evaluated. That ranking cannot compare Scroll Box's early development with the elite relic.

adaptive.limits: Actual prefixes only. All candidates remain available with their own sample count. Full-run agreement is an independent admission result, not observed during an early-stopped question.

sign_audit.limits: Conditional simulation audit only. Missing attribution is not zero; unrecorded healing stays unknown. Not a calibration of real wins.

readiness.limits: Linear constant-rate approximation for diagnosis only, never ranking. Extra damage changes fight duration; extra HP ignores scaling and play order. Missing or censored samples are not losses. Monte Carlo intervals exclude model and calibration uncertainty.

boss_relative_margin.limits: 同一模拟窗口含准备轮及终止轮，入口血量固定；战中题仅代表从当前回合到终止的剩余窗口。敌方DPR计减伤后的敌人响应及持有/回合末状态伤害，不仅是攻击意图；自伤/回血无法拆分时未知。S不是胜率。缺失归属、截断及连续多Boss不补零；子集均值不能作全体排序。自伤、回血、复活和死亡时序仍独立检查；模型未校准不因样本完成而可信。
